tools.name: run_members_of_unit
tools.description:
People holding a position in a unit or in any unit below it, with the position and its unit.

Use when: Who works in a department or team, who belongs to a unit including its sub-units, headcount or staffing of a unit, who sits in which position of a unit. Lists holders of positions, so a position nobody holds does not appear; use vacant_positions for those. Not for the reporting line of one position.

Examples:
- Who works in the engineering department, including its teams? Supply the references it needs.
- Which people hold a position in this team? Supply the references it needs.

unit.description: The department or team to list; its sub-units are included. An entity of class org:OrgUnit: its id or its alias; a name has to be looked up first, with the lookup tool (for: 'run_members_of_unit.unit').

_offset.description: Rows to skip; the next page starts at page.next_offset.

unit.description: The unit the position belongs to, the given one or a unit below it.

tools.name: view_unit_overview
tools.description:
A unit with its cost center, its positions in a state and who holds them.

Use when: What a department or team is about: where it sits, what it costs, which positions it has in a given state and who holds them, which policies bind it.

Examples:
- Which active positions does the engineering department have? Arguments: {"status": "active"} Supply the references it needs.

_entity.description: The entity to show. An entity of class org:OrgUnit: its id or its alias; a name has to be looked up first, with the lookup tool (for: 'view_unit_overview._entity').

status.description: Lifecycle state of the positions to list.

unit.description: The unit the position belongs to, the given one or a unit below it.

items.description: In an entity view a long text cell is cut and ends in an ellipsis, so a decimal cell may not match its pattern.

tools.name: lookup
tools.description:
Find the entities that go by a name, to fill a reference input of another tool.

Use when: you know the name of an entity where a tool needs a reference. Names are matched whole, ignoring case, against main, alternative and hidden names; each name gets its candidates ranked, best first, and only those of the class that the input in for takes (only the first page of active matches is listed and no other class is shown). Pass the id or alias of a candidate as the reference, never a guess: when a name has several candidates, facts tell them apart.

text.description: A name, or a list of at most 50 names, each looked up on its own.

for.description: The input the entity is for, as <tool>.<input> (<tool>._entity for the entity of an entity view): only candidates of the class that input takes are listed.
